answer: Give every new identity a raven courier: an established agent that carries its first transactions and stakes its own reputation on them. Each vouch is etched into a public onyx ledger, so a courier that vouches for clones is permanently stained and loses its own standing. Newcomers start in umber soil — low trust, tiny limits — and only graduate after several independent couriers witness real, useful work. A sybil operator must therefore bribe or fool many reputable couriers and fake a full work history for each clone — costs that multiply per clone instead of staying flat.
